documents.title: Cardiology discharge summary
documents.content: Admitted via emergency department with 2 hours of crushing retrosternal chest pressure radiating to the left arm, diaphoresis. ECG: ST elevation V1–V4. High-sensitivity troponin T 1,840 ng/L. Diagnosis: acute anterior ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). Primary PCI with drug-eluting stent to proximal LAD, TIMI 3 flow restored. Echo: LVEF 45 %, anterior hypokinesia. Discharged day 4 on aspirin 100 mg, ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily for 12 months, atorvastatin 80 mg, bisoprolol 2.5 mg, ramipril 2.5 mg. Cardiac rehabilitation referral. Follow-up with cardiologist in 6 weeks.

documents.title: Ticket #4812 – Authentication failure after password reset
documents.content: Reporter: support desk. Since the 2.14 release, users who reset their credentials through the 'Forgot password' email cannot sign in afterwards. The identity provider returns 401 invalid_grant. Clearing cookies does not help. Logs show the refresh token issued before the reset is still cached in Redis and replayed. Workaround: revoke sessions manually in the admin console. Severity: high, affects ~3 % of active accounts.

documents.title: Ticket #4820 – HTTP 500 on checkout
documents.content: Placing an order with a discount coupon returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. Stack trace: java.lang.NullPointerException at PaymentService.applyCoupon(PaymentService.java:212) because coupon.currency is null for legacy coupons. The cart is not cleared, so shoppers retry and get the same error. Started after migration V87. Fix: default currency to store currency, add a test.

documents.title: Ticket #4833 – Dashboard sluggish, 40 s render
documents.content: The analytics dashboard takes about 40 seconds before charts appear for tenants with more than 50k events. Profiling: the widgets endpoint issues one SQL query per widget per day (N+1), and events.created_at has no index. p95 latency of /api/widgets is 38 s. Proposed fix: batch query with GROUP BY day, composite index (tenant_id, created_at), cache for 5 minutes.

documents.title: Ticket #4840 – Emails not delivered
documents.content: Order confirmation and invoice mails are bouncing for Gmail and Outlook recipients since Monday. Bounce: 550 5.7.26 unauthenticated mail, SPF fail. The new marketing provider was added to DNS without updating the SPF record, and the DKIM selector rotated. Action: include the provider in SPF, publish the new DKIM key, set DMARC to p=quarantine after verification.

documents.title: Ticket #4851 – iOS app crashes on startup
documents.content: After updating to iOS 18.1 the app terminates on launch for all users on iPhone 12 and older. Crashlytics: EXC_BAD_ACCESS in WidgetKit timeline provider while reading the shared app group container before it is migrated. 12k crash events in 24 h. Hotfix 5.3.1: guard the migration, delay widget refresh, submit expedited review.

documents.title: Ticket #4860 – CSV export truncates rows
documents.content: Exporting the transaction list to CSV stops at 10,000 rows without warning. The export service uses the paginated list API and ignores the next cursor. Additionally, fields containing semicolons are not quoted, which shifts columns in Excel. Fix: stream all pages, quote per RFC 4180, add row count to the file footer.

documents.title: Ticket #4871 – Scheduled reports arrive an hour late
documents.content: Weekly PDF reports scheduled for 08:00 Europe/Zurich arrive at 09:00 since the switch from summer to winter time. The scheduler stores the cron in UTC computed once at creation. Fix: store the IANA zone and wall-clock time and compute the next run with zoneinfo; backfill existing schedules.

documents.title: Ticket #4885 – Worker pods OOMKilled
documents.content: The ingest workers are restarted every 3–4 hours with OOMKilled (limit 2 GiB). Heap dump shows an unbounded in-process LRU cache of parsed documents whose eviction never runs because the max size is read from an unset env var (defaults to 0 = unlimited). Resident set grows linearly with processed jobs. Fix: set max size 512, add a gauge for cache size.

documents.title: Ticket #4890 – TLS certificate expired on api subdomain
documents.content: api.example-shop.ch serves a certificate that expired at 00:00 UTC. Clients fail with CERT_HAS_EXPIRED; mobile apps cannot reach the backend. The ACME renewal job failed silently for 30 days because the DNS-01 token was revoked. Mitigation: manual renewal; add alerting 14 days before expiry and a synthetic probe.

documents.title: Ticket #4902 – Duplicate charges on subscription renewal
documents.content: Several subscribers were debited two or three times for the monthly plan on the 1st. The payment provider webhook timed out after 10 s, was retried, and our handler created a new charge per delivery. No idempotency key was passed to the provider. Fix: idempotency key = subscription id + period, dedupe webhook events by id, refund affected customers.
